milestone_scope: m1 (seed world): `up` provisions the bundled postgres-starter world and records its manifest; `status` prints services plus the seeded-state fingerprint. `checkpoint`, `diff`, and `run` are roadmap stubs in this build.
prerequisites: worldcheck binary: go build ./cmd/worldcheck (or go install github.com/SuperMarioYL/worldcheck/cmd/worldcheck@latest after the first release)
scenario: Provision the bundled seeded test world, read back its state fingerprint, then edit seed.sql, re-provision, and observe the fingerprint change (the m1 acceptance criterion).

steps.purpose: verify reproducibility: same seed reproduces the same fingerprint

verification: go test ./... — unit tests plus the real-world integration test (TestProvisionRealPostgresStarterWorld) pass on a machine with Docker; unit tests stay green with -short or without a Docker daemon (fake runner).
The integration test provisions the same seed twice and requires identical fingerprints, then edits seed.sql and requires the fingerprint to change.
limitations: m2 (checkpoint/diff) and m3 (run + worldcheck.html reconciliation report) are stubs: the commands exist and print the roadmap note to stderr instead of executing.
The demo GIF records the m1 provisioning leg only; the plan's full demo (an agent caught mutating its own world by the diff) arrives with m3 and replaces this recording.
Windows is out of scope for v0.1; macOS and Linux are supported.
